_doc: Symbol -> TOPIC CLAUSE for the X allowlist path. A wire writes PROSE, not cashtags: measured 2026-09-06, the shipped '($SPY) AND from:<wires>' query returns 0 posts for SPY, QQQ and IWM every time, and collapses TSLA/NVDA onto a single account (@DeItaone, one of the very few wires that prefixes cashtags). Expressing the topic the way a wire writes it returns 8/25/1/25/25 posts across 2/3/1/6/7 distinct vetted sources. Keep the cashtag as an OR term so trader-style posts still match. This map governs the ALLOWLIST path only; the unfiltered volume query must keep using the cashtag, because that is what measures trader attention.
_unmapped_behaviour: A symbol with no entry falls back to the cashtag alone. That is a WEAK query against wire accounts, so the payload must say so: absence under a cashtag-only topic is NOT evidence the wires were silent. Report topic_expressed_as: 'cashtag_only' and let the caller state the limit.
_false_positive_warning: A keyword clause matches the COMPANY, not the STOCK. Measured example: 'Tesla' returned a WSJ piece on SpaceX and Tesla directors funding academic research - real, from a vetted wire, and not a market catalyst. A post is therefore a CANDIDATE catalyst only. NoVo may report that a vetted wire published X, and may never assert that X caused a move.

SPY.note: index, not the ETF - wires write the index name

QQQ.note: bare Nasdaq is broad but wires rarely write 'Nasdaq 100'

IWM.note: genuinely thin - 1 post in the probe. Honest, not broken

TSLA.note: high false-positive rate via SpaceX/Musk coverage

META.note: 'Meta' is a common word - wire tier keeps this usable

BTC.note: crypto tier; Xavier's identity rule still binds
